post.summary: Send a 6-digit one-time code (same response whether or not an account exists)
Verify the code; returns access + refresh tokens bound to this device
Rotate the refresh token (single use; reuse revokes the session)
Check the PIN (app unlock fallback); same lockout as step-up
Exchange PIN or device-key signature for a single-use 2-minute step-up token
Start adding a card: returns the partner-hosted page URL (card details never reach XenDirekt)
Finish adding a card from a completed setup; eligibility is checked server-side
Registered account name for an MTN MoMo number (or merchant code when enabled)
Fee, FX rate and card-currency total, valid for 5 minutes
Pay a quote. Same Idempotency-Key + same body returns the original payment (200).

get.summary: Live status (poll while not final); includes the receipt once completed

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: ISO timestamp: notifications created before this

info.title: XenDirekt API
info.description: Payment orchestration API for the XenDirekt mobile app (/v1) and internal operations (/v1/admin). Errors use a stable envelope: { error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }.

destination.description: Email address, or international phone number in E.164 (+...)

deviceId.description: App-generated install ID (random UUID kept in secure storage)

signature.description: base64 signature over the challenge signingMessage

acceptLegalTerms.description: true = the user tapped Continue under the Terms/Privacy notice (current versions are recorded)

publicKey.description: Ed25519: raw 32-byte key, base64. ES256: SPKI DER, base64.

value.description: Validated against the schema for this key

approvalReference.description: Business approval evidence (e.g. PM sign-off). Without it the version is unapproved and production will not price with it.

identifier.description: As typed or pasted; normalised server-side

amountRwf.description: Whole Rwandan francs the merchant receives

note.description: Optional note for the merchant SMS, e.g. "2 baskets"

idempotencyKey.description: 8–100 chars; the same key returns the same refund request

value.description: User ID, card fingerprint, payee ID or device hash
